capabilities.description: Enable guests to search, select, and reserve hotel rooms, and hoteliers to manage reservations, including modifications and cancellations.
Allow hoteliers to list and manage properties, room types, amenities, and availability calendars.
Implement pricing rules based on demand, seasonality, and occupancy to optimize revenue and offer competitive rates.
Collect and display guest reviews and ratings to build trust and provide feedback to hoteliers.
Provide dashboards for hoteliers to monitor bookings, revenue, and occupancy trends, and for administrators to oversee platform performance.
Send automated notifications for booking confirmations, reminders, and updates to guests and hoteliers.
Provide personalized hotel recommendations and search results based on user preferences and behavior.

summary: A comprehensive platform for hotel booking that enables guests to search, compare, and reserve rooms while providing hoteliers with tools to manage inventory, pricing, and reservations. It serves travelers, hotel staff, and administrators with a seamless booking experience and efficient property management.
